mapper.select: SELECT A.QNA_ID, A.PRODUCT_ID, A.BRANCH_ID, A.USER_NO, A.TITLE, A.CONTENTS, A.ATCH_DOC_ID, A.SECRET_YN, A.QNA_STATUS, A.ANSWER_CONTENTS, A.ANSWERER_NO, A.ANSWERED_AT, A.REGIST_DT, U.USER_NM, B.BRANCH_NAME, (SELECT USER_NM FROM op_user WHERE USER_NO = A.ANSWERER_NO) AS ANSWERER_NM FROM tb_product_qna A INNER JOIN op_user U ON A.USER_NO = U.USER_NO INNER JOIN tb_branches B ON A.BRANCH_ID = B.BRANCH_ID WHERE A.QNA_ID = #{qnaId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product_qna ( PRODUCT_ID, BRANCH_ID, USER_NO, TITLE, CONTENTS, ATCH_DOC_ID, SECRET_YN, QNA_STATUS, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{branchId}, #{ss_user_no}, #{title}, #{contents}, #{atchDocId}, IFNULL(#{secretYn}, 'N'), '10', #{ss_user_no}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product_qna SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENTS = #{contents}, ATCH_DOC_ID = #{atchDocId}, SECRET_YN = #{secretYn}, UPDUSR_NO = #{ss_user_no}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId} AND USER_NO = #{ss_user_no}

UPDATE tb_product_qna SET QNA_STATUS = '20', ANSWER_CONTENTS = #{answerContents}, ANSWERER_NO = #{ss_user_no}, ANSWERED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, REGISTER_NO = #{ss_user_no}, UPDUSR_NO = #{ss_user_no}, USER_NO = #{ss_user_no}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId}
